تستلهمون (form X)
# تَسْتَلْهِمُونَ (tastalhimūna) /tas.tal.hi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# تُسْتَلْهَمُونَ (tustalhamūna) /tus.tal.ha.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
